;Armed conflict and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]]
**In [[Kabul]], seven are killed after suicide bombers and gunmen attack the [[Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (Afghanistan)|communications ministry]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47996762 (BBC)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants kill 50 [[Syrian Armed Forces|Syrian soldiers]] in two days of clashes in the [[Syria]]n desert. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/04/separate-attacks-kill-50-syrian-soldiers-190420184829713.html (Al Jazeera)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Egyptian constitutional referendum]], [[Arab Winter]]
**[[Egypt]]ians vote on a number of [[Constitutional amendment|amendment]]s to the [[Constitution of Egypt]], which, among other things, allow [[President of Egypt|President]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] to remain in power until 2030, increase the president's powers over [[Judiciary of Egypt|Egypt's judiciary]], and increase the power of [[Egyptian Armed Forces|Egypt's military]] over all other state institutions. The vote takes place over three days from 20 to 22 April. [https://www.apnews.com/23ae0174b4624265a1440198f02460c8 (AP News)]
